gizmo.title: Zanen radar
gizmo.description: Zanen radar (gizo-gizo) don samfuran balaga da bayar da maki ta fuskoki, kamar HEOSAT. Ya haɗa da madadin rubutu da teburin bayanai.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Kanun labari don zanen; ana kuma amfani da shi a matsayin sunansa mai sauƙin isa.

configure.title: Rukunoni
configure.description: Rukuni ɗaya a kowane layi. Yana buƙatar aƙalla 3.

configure.title: Maki
configure.description: Lambobi da aka raba da waƙafi, ɗaya don kowane rukuni a tsari ɗaya.

configure.description: Lambobi da aka raba da waƙafi, ɗaya don kowane rukuni a tsari ɗaya.

configure.title: Ƙarami
configure.description: Ƙaramin zane ba tare da lakabi, maɓalli ko teburin bayanai ba. Shawagi a kan wuri don ganin ƙimominsa.
